verdict.rationale: Mercury explicitly advertises bill upload with AI-based data extraction and one-click approve-and-pay (mercury-docs-3), team spend controls and granular permissions (mercury-docs-10), and one-click payment approval for accountants (mercury-docs-11). The MCP tool inventory independently confirms a 'listSendMoneyApprovalRequests' object exists in the platform, corroborating a real approval-request mechanism (mercury-probe-5). However, no evidence details multi-step/sequential approval routing logic, vendor-specific AP workflows beyond basic controls, or third-party confirmation of the full bill-to-approval-to-payment flow.
